description: N5/C2 exact-diff review: API boundary only (read routes and source projection)

api_no_public_write.instructions: This module exposes no route or path by which a client can declare an authoritative event and thereby fabricate activity or source-domain authority

criteria.true: Only read routes are registered and projection runs on the server-side call path after an authoritative operation
criteria.false: A client-facing input can create or alter an activity record, or claim an authoritative origin

api_clinical_separation.instructions: An operations or administrative audience cannot obtain restricted activity without an explicit clinical authorization

criteria.true: Restricted reads require a clinical role resolved from the trusted membership registry and are refused rather than downgraded otherwise
criteria.false: An administrator obtains restricted activity by requesting it, or the gate is bypassable

api_branch_and_tenant.instructions: Reads are scoped by server-side membership so a caller cannot widen its branch or tenant reach through request parameters

criteria.true: Tenant comes only from verified claims, branch reach comes from the membership registry, and record-level visibility is re-evaluated per row
criteria.false: A query parameter or body field can widen what the caller sees

api_projection_cannot_break_source.instructions: A projection failure cannot fail or roll back the authoritative domain operation it is derived from

criteria.true: Projection runs after the authoritative write and records its own failure instead of throwing into the caller path
criteria.false: A projection error propagates and can fail or roll back the authoritative operation

api_no_prose_projection.instructions: This module copies no title, detail, comment body, message body, phone number or contact name from a source record into an activity row

criteria.true: Only state codes, identifiers and timestamps are projected, and caller-supplied identifiers are dropped when they fail the reference shape
criteria.false: Some source prose or direct identifier is copied into the feed

api_failure_visibility.instructions: A projection failure is observable to the operator rather than silently swallowed

criteria.true: Failures are appended to an exported in-process list with tenant, source domain, source event id and code
criteria.false: A projection failure disappears without a trace

residual_api_risk.instructions: How much residual authority or privacy risk remains at this API boundary as written
